text: Yes, the 2022 loss of 0.6 hectares was corroborated by the independent reference (JRC GFC2020 V4). The corroboration rule required that a later year of the series observed and the JRC 2020 reference agreed on >= 50% of the event area. The JRC data showed that the entire event area (100%) was mapped as forest in 2020, satisfying the corroboration rule. Additionally, the loss was observed in the Hansen GFC data, and the event area was within the valid data fraction for Hansen GFC.
